notes.title: 0.4.4 - A Little Quality of Life
notes.content:
[h2]Shop Items[/h2]
[list]
[*]Buy All shop item feature! Experience the convenience of buying everything you can afford with a single click! This features buys shop items from cheapest to most expensive
[/list]
[h2]Farmhand[/h2]
[list]
[*]Sleep time now factors into offline progression. This and the next two items will bring Farmhand offline progression to be much closer to active progression at the appropriate stages of the game
[*]Golden harvest only factors in for offline if it is unlocked
[*]Offline progression for simulated clicks only factors in if autofarm is unlocked
[*]Offline progression simulated clicks now count as clicks regarding the Passive Income achievement (in other words, they will invalidate an attempt for this achievement)
[/list]
[h2]Squire[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Enemy! This should help for people trying to hit the level cap on Squire
[*]Fixed an issue where defeating boss 2 would allow full access to dungeon 3 (every enemy) right away
[/list]
[h2]Researcher[/h2]
[list]
[*]Page submission has been significantly sped up. If you have the pages to complete a chapter, then it's completed instantly, then the rest of your pages fill the progress bar like before
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where loading a save file while skills were on cooldown could sometimes crash the game
[/list]

notes.title: 0.4.3 - Fixing Things!
notes.content:
[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
[list]
[*] A plugged in controller will no longer map to HFI even if HFI is out of focus
[/list]
[h2]Farmhand[/h2]
[list]
[*] Burning the Midnight Oil Rank 2 cooldown reduction is now working properly
[/list]
[h2]Squire[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Squires offline farming very weak enemies at very high level could get insane XP
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievement menu items no longer become temporarily unresponsive
[/list]

notes.title: 0.4.2 - Player Feedback Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Offline Progression / Browser AFK Overhaul[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gold, XP and Research Pages are now awarded for browser players when they return to a suspended tab (woo!)
[*] Any changes to offline also affect this new browser AFK system as they are using the same foundation. The idea here is to significantly narrow the gap between active and AFK play as the gap was much too large before
[*] Farmhand offline progression now simulates autofarming as well as passive XP and Gold gains
[*] Farmhand cooldowns are now reset if enough time has passed while AFK in the browser
[*] Squire offline progression is now 100% of calculated offline kills (up from 25%)
[*] Researcher offline progression is now 100% of calculated random research (up from 25% for XP, and up from 10% for pages). Researcher offline progression still simulates two random researches once multitasking is unlocked
[*] Researcher skill Epiphany now resets if enough time has passed while AFK in the browser
[*] Offline / AFK time is now added to time stats (time played, time played in a class, time in rebirth)
[*] When tabbing away from HFI in the browser, music and sound instantly mutes if you have the out of focus preference set
[/list]
[h2]Farmhand[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sleep restored per second starts at 5 instead of 2.5
[*] Sleep restored per second rebirth stat scaling has been reduced
[*] Eat Food can now be activated while autofarming if you have empowered hunger
[*] Farmhand levels up much faster when a large amount of experience is gained all at once
[/list]
[h2]Squire[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemy XP reward scales a little faster than before (meaning going to do the tougher enemy is more likely to reward for XP per second)
[*] Added an entry for Poison and Crit Resistance in the Info section
[*] Made the Total XP and Gold Per Second estimate a bit more accurate
[*] Fixed an issue where Brace rank 2 couldn't be cast until you have 25% stamina (even though it costs 10%)
[*] While recovering, you can no longer activate a skill and waste the stamina to no effect
[/list]
[h2]Researcher[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added secondary Research stat bonuses to the Rebirth tab and fixed some tooltip issues
[*] Updated Quality Ink wording (reduces research TIME by X%)
[*] Book color, titles and class buff text persist if you have already published the book once
[*] Normalized the speed at which the submit pages progress bar goes
[*] Rebalanced Researcher XP gains (More natural wisdom scaling, less XP Per Research available)
[*] Shop Items have had their costs adjusted slightly
[*] Epiphany is now disabled while you are publishing a book
[*] Gold Per Second stat now displays the correct amount of gold per second happening
[*] Professional Development tooltip has been updated to represent a multiplier instead of percentage for the increase
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Level Cap is now 75 (until more content is added)
[*] Big number system implemented - XP, Gold and Rebirth calculations (these handle much larger numbers now)
[*] Shop item discount is no longer being applied twice
[*] Clarified how some rebirth stats don't kick in until higher numbers in the info section
[*] A new current rebirth timer (How long have you been in your current run)
[*] A new timer for last rebirth stat obtained (How long did it take you to get your last rebirth stat in the current run)
[*] Base stat bonuses are now displayed separately from the fully multiplied bonus (ex: Gold Per Second)
[*] Added shadows to class icons
[*] Added two new Secret achievements
[*] Simplified the rebirth stat bonus wording by removing the percentages and changing them to straight multipliers
[*] Misc bug fixes and UI improvements
[/list]

notes.title: 0.4.1 - Road to Level 50 Part 1.5
notes.content:
[h2]Controller Support 🎮[/h2] 
- Controller support is here! HFI can be now be fully played with a controller, both in the Steam and Web versions. Consider this feature to be in beta; more controller types need to be tested and still need to add full Steam Input support. Note: Tooltips do not appear while using a controller and the Load Game dialog box cannot be controlled with a controller.

[h2]Farmhand[/h2]
 The A Balanced Breakfast shop item now rewards a new stat: Minimum Hunger. This allows your hunger to never go below 10%!
- Reduced the power of the first Researcher book the Farmhand uses (Still starts at 20% XP and Gold, but now only grants +0.5% to each stat per edition instead of +1%)
- Reworded the Empowered Hunger perk to be a bit clearer

[h2]Squire[/h2]
- Brace for Impact now doubles your Defense and reduces damage taken by 50%. (used to reduce damage by 75%) Thorns builds rejoice!
- Protect Your Vitals now rewards +5% Crit Resistance (used to be 3%)
- Deflect and Counter now rewards +3% Crit Resistance and +30% Crit Damage (used to be +1% and +20%)
- Reduced the damage variance of both Squire and enemies (higher minimum damage for both). This is intended to make combat feel a little less unpredictable.
- Reduced Crit Damage from the Researcher book to a max of +100% (used to be a max of +200%)

[h2]Researcher[/h2]
- Reduced XP Per Research for a handful of perks
- Epiphany has been reworked: now a 2 min cooldown, rewards significantly more pages, and now factors in Might and the speed of active researches
- Editions past the first have a +10% increase in pages needed per chapter.
- Fully "edition completed" book will now be permanently completed. This means gold from these books is granted immediately after a rebirth.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
- Steam Deck: If HFI is coming out of suspend it will now reward offline progression as if the game was fully shut down.
- Unskilled Labor + Grit and Determination had their eligibility criteria resolved.
- A few fixed misc bugs.
